facts.value: Occupational health psychology is a branch of psychology that is interdisciplinary. It is concerned with the health and safety of workers.
facts.programme_association: Psychology and Sociology - BA | University of Limerick

facts.value: Impact of occupational stressors on physical and mental health, mistreatment of workers (e.g., bullying and violence), work-family balance, impact of involuntary unemployment on physical and mental health, influence of psychosocial factors on safety and accidents, and interventions designed to improve/protect worker health.
facts.programme_association: Psychology and Sociology - BA | University of Limerick

facts.value: OHP grew out of health psychology, industrial and organizational psychology, and occupational medicine. It has also been informed by disciplines outside psychology, including industrial engineering, sociology, and economics.
facts.programme_association: Psychology and Sociology - BA | University of Limerick
